import Foundation
import OCCTBridge

// Hand-written shadows for the three entry points generate-shadow.py cannot map (they take a
// pointer to an array of references). Copied to Sources/OCCTSwift/InjectionShadowExtra.swift for
// the sweep, deleted afterwards, never committed there. Same B3_SWITCH gate as the generated file.

func OCCTLocOpeGlue(
    _ baseShape: OCCTShapeRef, _ gluedShape: OCCTShapeRef,
    _ baseFaces: UnsafePointer<OCCTShapeRef>, _ gluedFaces: UnsafePointer<OCCTShapeRef>,
    _ faceCount: Int32,
    _ baseEdges: UnsafePointer<OCCTShapeRef?>?, _ gluedEdges: UnsafePointer<OCCTShapeRef?>?,
    _ edgeCount: Int32
) -> OCCTShapeRef? {
    if GD.on("OCCTLocOpeGlue_RET_NIL") { return nil }
    var n = faceCount
    if GD.on("OCCTLocOpeGlue_DROP_LAST_PAIR") { n -= 1 }
    // swap which shape's face is bound to which: base faces against base faces
    let g = GD.on("OCCTLocOpeGlue_BIND_BASE_FACES_TO_THEMSELVES") ? baseFaces : gluedFaces
    return OCCTBridge.OCCTLocOpeGlue(
        baseShape, gluedShape, baseFaces, g, n, baseEdges, gluedEdges, edgeCount)
}

func OCCTLocOpeSplitByWires(
    _ shape: OCCTShapeRef, _ wiresOnFaces: UnsafePointer<OCCTShapeRef>, _ pairCount: Int32,
    _ outDirectLeft: UnsafeMutablePointer<UnsafeMutablePointer<OCCTShapeRef?>?>,
    _ outDirectLeftCount: UnsafeMutablePointer<Int32>
) -> OCCTShapeRef? {
    if GD.on("OCCTLocOpeSplitByWires_RET_NIL") { return nil }
    var n = pairCount
    if GD.on("OCCTLocOpeSplitByWires_DROP_LAST_PAIR") { n -= 1 }
    let r = OCCTBridge.OCCTLocOpeSplitByWires(
        shape, wiresOnFaces, n, outDirectLeft, outDirectLeftCount)
    if GD.on("OCCTLocOpeSplitByWires_DIRECT_LEFT_ZERO") { outDirectLeftCount.pointee = 0 }
    return r
}

func OCCTLocOpeSplitByWiresAuto(
    _ shape: OCCTShapeRef, _ wires: UnsafePointer<OCCTShapeRef>, _ wireCount: Int32
) -> OCCTShapeRef? {
    if GD.on("OCCTLocOpeSplitByWiresAuto_RET_NIL") { return nil }
    var n = wireCount
    if GD.on("OCCTLocOpeSplitByWiresAuto_DROP_LAST_WIRE") { n -= 1 }
    return OCCTBridge.OCCTLocOpeSplitByWiresAuto(shape, wires, n)
}
